## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive; confirmed by weak sector breadth (≤4/11) and defensive/utility strength (VST, CEG, JNJ) outperforming; note MAJOR divergence across big-cap Tech (AAPL, MSFT, META) which tempers conviction.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leads: XOM (1W: +7.50% | 1M: +12.28%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +5.74% | 1M: +10.48%) ABOVE TREND. Utilities/Industrials follow: VST (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +4.06%) ABOVE TREND, LMT (1W: +10.72% | 1M: +12.89%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Technology, Communication and Consumer Discretionary lag: GOOGL (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -8.22%) BELOW TREND, TMUS (1W: -11.63% | 1M: -7.67%) BELOW TREND, TSLA (1W: -18.25% | 1M: -16.23%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: VST (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +4.06%) ABOVE TREND; LMT (1W: +10.72% | 1M: +12.89%) ABOVE TREND; CEG (1W: +9.46% | 1M: +1.98%) ABOVE TREND; HON (1W: +8.81% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND; FCX (1W: +8.44% | 1M: -1.16%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Broad (3 sectors in Top 5); style: Value/Cyclical.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: META (1W: -8.79% | 1M: +7.81%) CORRECTION; CMCSA (1W: -9.05% | 1M: -2.55%) BELOW TREND; CRM (1W: -9.12% | 1M: +2.29%) CORRECTION; ADBE (1W: -9.83% | 1M: +7.47%) CORRECTION; GOOGL (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -8.22%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in high-multiple Tech/Comm names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W movers: VST (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +4.06%) ABOVE TREND, LMT (1W: +10.72% | 1M: +12.89%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +9.46% | 1M: +1.98%) ABOVE TREND; MAJOR divergence flagged as multiple mega-caps show 1W/1M mismatch (AAPL, MSFT, META) — tactical, not structural.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Tech is under pressure with mixed internal leadership: NVDA (1W: +0.66% | 1M: +4.36%) ABOVE TREND while AAPL (1W: -3.48% | 1M: +9.30%) CORRECTION and MSFT (1W: -4.87% | 1M: +2.04%) CORRECTION; expect continued dispersion and headline-driven moves.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials are mixed: JPM (1W: +1.97% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND while V (1W: -3.71% | 1M: +7.04%) CORRECTION and MA (1W: -3.85% | 1M: +8.83%) CORRECTION — not a clear risk-on lift for the group.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare shows selective defensive strength: JNJ (1W: +3.72% | 1M: +8.44%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +0.04% | 1M: +3.50%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +1.43% | 1M: +7.12%) ABOVE TREND; sector overall is mixed but has safe-haven demand.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor Energy and Utilities exposure (XOM (1W: +7.50% | 1M: +12.28%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +4.06%) ABOVE TREND) and select Industrials (LMT, RTX); reduce exposure to stretched Tech/high-multiple names showing CORRECTION (GOOGL, ADBE, CRM). Style: Value/Cyclical favored while monitoring Tech divergence.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: RTX (1W: +7.61% | 1M: +12.22%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +7.50% | 1M: +12.28%) ABOVE TREND, LMT (1W: +10.72% | 1M: +12.89%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: GOOGL (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -8.22%) BELOW TREND, TSLA (1W: -18.25% | 1M: -16.23%) BELOW TREND, META (1W: -8.79% | 1M: +7.81%) CORRECTION.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy, Utilities, Industrials (momentum and earnings/upgrades visible). BEARISH: Technology, Communication Services, Consumer Discretionary (breadth weak and several leaders in CORRECTION/BELLOW TREND).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch NVDA (1W: +0.66% | 1M: +4.36%) ABOVE TREND for sustainable follow-through above recent highs to confirm tech relief; AAPL (1W: -3.48% | 1M: +9.30%) CORRECTION needs to stop below-week weakness to re-enter trend; GOOGL (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -8.22%) BELOW TREND — breach of recent lows would widen leadership shift.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
RTX (+80): RTX (1W: +7.61% | 1M: +12.22%) ABOVE TREND — Q2 raise confirms price action (sentiment confirmed). NOW (+80): NOW (1W: -11.60% | 1M: -4.17%) BELOW TREND — upgraded outlook but price is diverging (bullish news, distribution).

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
META (-45): META (1W: -8.79% | 1M: +7.81%) CORRECTION — higher financing costs are pressuring shares and price confirms weakness. TSLA (-40): TSLA (1W: -18.25% | 1M: -16.23%) BELOW TREND — negative narrative on robotaxi execution compounds sharp price decline.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF (Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive); leadership: Broad (3 sectors in Top 5) and style: Value/Cyclical favored. Energy and Utilities showing relative strength — XOM (1W: +7.50% | 1M: +12.28%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +4.06%) ABOVE TREND. Key risk: major Tech divergence (AAPL, MSFT, META in CORRECTION) and news-driven dispersion (NOW vs RTX) — monitor for confirmation before reversing positioning.
